states-attorney.note_extra: Mid-term change: the 2022 winner, Todd A. Shove, no longer holds the office; the Department page lists Aliena Gerhard as the sitting State's Attorney (see county notes).

sources.note: Office of Governor Phil Scott press release, June 4, 2024: Governor Scott appointed Aliena Gerhard as Lamoille County State's Attorney, replacing Todd Shove. Gerhard joined the office as a deputy in 2021 and had served as acting State's Attorney since Shove's resignation in December 2023; her appointed term concludes January 31, 2027.
Department of State's Attorneys and Sheriffs, Lamoille County office page: lists Aliena Gerhard as the sitting State's Attorney as of the October 2026 retrieval.

sa_transition.build_note: Shove: person + 2022 candidacy + winner entry, NO membership (resigned Dec 2023). Gerhard: person + membership, how_seated appointed, no candidacy.
